sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Bolt-action Rifles is a Combat skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The Bolt-action rifles weapon skill is improved by firing and reloading the corresponding weapon type.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- Level 7 of this skill is needed for the quest Wet Job - Part 6
- Level 10 of this skill is needed for the quest Psycho Sniper
- Level 10 of this skill is needed for the quest Make an Impression

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases reload speed (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Increases weapon switching speed (0.8% per level → +40% at Elite Level)
- Reduces weapon recoil (0.3% per level → -15% at Elite Level)
- Improves weapon ergonomics (0.2% per level → +10% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Steady aim for the first 3 seconds with any stamina condition
- Elite level: Doubles mastering gain

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Landing hits on enemies with bolt-action rifles
- Reloading bolt-action rifles
- Cycling the action/Unloading the chambers of bolt-action rifles
- Completing the quest Shooter Born in Heaven
- Completing the quest Psycho Sniper
